name: mendix-security-analyzer
description: Mendix Studio Pro extension (10.24+) that checks an app against security governance rules

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/application-ir && npm run build -w packages/rule-engine && npm run build -w packages/scoring && npm run build -w packages/rules && npm run build -w packages/mendix-parser
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm run build:dotnet
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && node --test "tests/**/*.test.mjs" "extension/tests/**/*.test.mjs"
